 Pikhalyonok criticizes Mykhavko's red card 
 Sharp Criticism Over Taras Mykhavko’s Sending Off
 According to Sport.ua : Oleksandr Pikhalyonok openly criticized the red card shown to Taras Mykhavko during the Ukrainian Cup clash where Dynamo suffered a 0-3 loss to Shakhtar Donetsk. He emphasized that such actions from players have a detrimental effect on the team’s performance.
 “This is exactly how you let the team down,” Pikhalyonok remarked, highlighting the pivotal moment that severely impacted the match outcome.
 Mykhavko’s dismissal was a turning point that significantly influenced the flow of the game. This incident underscores the crucial role that discipline plays in team sports, as losing a player can drastically alter both the momentum and morale on the field.
 Lessons for Dynamo Moving Forward
 In the context of this season’s Ukrainian Cup, Dynamo’s defeat to Shakhtar serves as a vital lesson. It stresses the importance of emotional control and maintaining composure during critical moments, essential for success in future matches.
 For English-speaking audiences, understanding how discipline and mindset affect team dynamics in football offers valuable insight into why such incidents can be game-changing.
